title: CTRL ALL: TRK + knob on every track
author: MrScruff (rytm-mods); elemod port: Iced-Cream
description: Holding TRK while turning a knob on a sound or TRIG page applies the same step to that parameter on tracks 1..12, keeping their differences. Stock behaviour with the FX track selected, with a trig key held, or on FX and global pages. Port of rytm-mods 0014-ctrl-all.
